meta.name: Mera Bhai
meta.description: This series shows the love-hate relationship of two brothers who happen to have, totally poles apart personalities. Bittu (Elder brother) is in his final year of college and is preparing for his job placement. Sittu (Younger brother) is in class 10th and is way too chill to be giving board exams the same year. This show captures the most relatable yet hilarious nuances of BHAI-BHAI relation.

videos.title: Blackmail
videos.overview: Upon finding out that his elder brother smokes with his friends, Sittu tries to manipulate him and get all his work done until Bittu gets frustrated and teaches him a lesson.

videos.title: Laparwahi
videos.overview: When Bittu invites his college pals over for a fictitious group discussion at his house, Sittu annoys them and demands Bittu's bike keys in return. When Jonty and Monty try to fool Sittu into doing a bike trick, they end up in an accident.

videos.title: Cousin Ki Entry
videos.overview: Sittu is swayed by his older cousin brother Sid's manner of life and lifestyle. Bittu discloses Sid’s reality once people learn about his fraud and lies.

videos.title: Bhaiyon Ki Ladai
videos.overview: Sittu accidentally says something hurtful to Bittu and now tries to convince him and apologizes by doing many tricks.

videos.title: Bhai Bhai
videos.overview: Bittu lies to his parents about his placement after realizing he couldn't get the job. When his father discovers his lies in the interim, he smacks him for his wrongdoings.
